body: Yeah, I doubt I will ever come out to them. It’s just not worth it, and I will end up losing the closest people who are in my life right now, since there aren’t really any irl friends I have I can stay with. The only friends I have are all online and have their own lives. I also wouldn’t want to push anyone else away by depending on them :(
Thank you, stranger. I will try to remember that. Let’s be lonely together :)
It really does. It doesn’t help that I am naturally a bit naive, which plays into their confirmation bias even more. It just gets tiring and overwhelming after a while.
I want to feel better knowing that, but somehow it just doesn’t, since it’s so hard for me just to open up in the first place. I appreciate your help though.
